steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Each competency is stacked with its levels, its definition and the jobs it links to.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 level does not rise above the level below

findings.title: Level that does not rise
findings.fix: Set each level above the one before

findings.title: Competency not linked to a job
findings.fix: Link it to the jobs that need it

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] levels.md:12  Level that does not rise.
       Fix: Set each level above the one before.
[medium] comp-delivery.md:19  Competency with no definition.
       Fix: Write the definition.
[low] job-link.csv:26  Competency not linked to a job.
       Fix: Link it to the jobs that need it.
Not checked: Validity of the framework.
pros: Checks a level that does not rise, a competency with no definition, and a competency not linked to a job.
cons: Not checked: Validity of the framework.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-competency-framework skill on the records for this review.
